Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Rajiv Ranjan, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Surendra Prasad Singh, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 2 26-02-2026 Heard Mr. Rajiv Ranjan, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. Surendra Prasad Singh representing the State.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Forbesganj P.S. Case No. 222 of 2025 for the offence registered under sections 21(c) of NDPS Act.

3. As per the prosecution story, the informant alleged that he along with the Police Force, during patrolling and on secret information, raided the house of Md. Qurban, he managed to escaped and on search, 365 liter codeine syrup of 100ml each were recovered/seized and led to the FIR.
4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that nothing has been recovered from his conscious possession rather from the house and as such, the seizure cannot be attributed to Patna High Court CR.

. 
5. Learned APP, Mr. Surendra Prasad Singh, on the other hand opposes the prayer submitting that a perusal of the FIR would show that he has seven criminal antecedents and it ranges from Section 376 of the IPC to 392 of the IPC and the present one, the NDPS case.

Further, the huge quantity has Qurban Ansari @ Md. Qurban @ Md. Qurban ... vs The State Of Bihar on 26 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54929745/
1 been recovered from his house.
6.
